# Apache Arrow JavaScript browser bundle provenance

The vendored browser distribution is Apache Arrow JavaScript `apache-arrow@21.2.0`, copied byte-for-byte from the cached npm package at:

```text
/tmp/jdv-20261014-arrow-js/deno/npm/registry.npmjs.org/apache-arrow/21.2.0/Arrow.es2015.min.js
```

The package metadata identifies version `21.2.0`, license `Apache-2.0`, upstream repository `https://github.com/apache/arrow-js`, and `Arrow.es2015.min.js` as both its `unpkg` and `jsdelivr` browser distribution. The self-contained UMD bundle is stored as `arrow-21.2.0.min.js`. The upstream `LICENSE.txt` and `NOTICE.txt` are preserved as `APACHE-ARROW-JS-LICENSE.txt` and `APACHE-ARROW-JS-NOTICE.txt`; the JavaScript file also retains its upstream Apache license header. `ARROW-JS-SHA256SUMS` records hashes for all three files.

This is vendoring only. No viewer integration or runtime loading has been added.
